c74object.name: evi.ramp0~
c74object.digest: Ramp generator, with options for zero-reset, loop, restingstate, curve and pause
c74object.description:
evi.ramp0~ is a 'max define' for the evi_ramp0.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.ramp0~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
A bit like MSP ramp~, with options for zero-reset, loop, restingstate, curve and pause.

inlet.description: Trigger the ramp generator, typically with a sync signal.

outlet.description: The ramp output 0..1. Speed depends on @duration attribute.
If @loop is on (default off) this sample accurately counts (accumulates) the number of loops since last reset, outputting an integer.
Sample accurate sync signal at every ramp start.
Sample accurate sync signal at every ramp end.

attribute.name: curve
attribute.description: If on (1) the ramp output is S-curve shaped. If off (0) the ramp output is linear.

attribute.name: duration
attribute.description: Set the duration of the ramp segment in ms. If @zeroreset is on, this is only updated on ramp zero-reset boundaries.

attribute.name: loop
attribute.description: Loop the ramp generator off/on. If off, the ramp is exclusively oneshot and only triggered by the 1st inlet. If on, the ramp behaves like a phasor.

attribute.name: pause
attribute.description: Pause (1) the ramp so that it freezes at the ramp value at the moment of engaging pause. The ramp is frozen until a 'pause 0' message is received. When coming out of pause state, the ramp simply continues from the value at which it was initially paused. Works whether @loop is on or off.

attribute.name: restingstate
attribute.description: At the end of a oneshot ramp (if @loop is off) does the ramp 'rest' at zero (0) or one (1)?

attribute.name: retrigger
attribute.description: Allow retriggering of the ramp during an active ramp segment, off/on 0/1

attribute.name: zeroreset
attribute.description: If on (1) the ramp is in zero-reset state, only updating the duration time at zero-reset crossings of the ramp. If off (0, the default) the ramp is free running.

c74object.discussion: I made this for my friend Rodrigo Constanzo
